scope: Bound combined private restoration and reject closed-session continuations

reproduction.method: Run unmount cases with HEAD App.tsx, preserving the edited source byte-for-byte and restoring it in a finally block.
reproduction.finding: Late decryption, connection, join and ledger-read results invoked the following restoration stage after App unmount.

earlierSelection.note: The initial narrower title filter matched no cases; it is not reproduction evidence.

behavior: After the panel reads a backup, decryption through ledger verification has a shared three-minute continuation deadline.
The application checks deadline and component generation before starting and after decrypt, wallet initialization, contract join, public read and ledger verification.
Only a current, verified result installs provider/API/private session state. Late continuations cannot start subsequent stages or replace a newer restored session.
Timeout preserves recovery inputs for explicit retry. Ordinary decryption/authority errors retain their existing messages and validation.

runs.scope: Initial 15 boundary cases plus existing application network and deployment checkpoint/reconnect regression.
Each of five await boundaries under unmount, timer expiry, undispatched wall expiry and undispatched monotonic expiry with backwards wall time.

browser.scope: Four new cases use real browser PBKDF2/AES with the first derived-key result held beyond a virtual three-minute deadline. Release before or during explicit retry preserves inputs, prevents an extra wallet connection, and keeps the new attempt busy. Six existing recovery-input and wallet-clock cases also pass.

initialRun.scope: Initial before-retry case plus the same regressions.

browserRelease.scope: Normal web build/typecheck and release manifest restored after Playwright environment build.

limits: Wallet/SDK stages are mocked in the new boundary tests; existing integration tests exercise real backup crypto and ledger-binding verification with mocked network providers.
Already-started wallet/SDK work is not cancelled. The guard blocks its continuation in this application.
The deadline starts when App receives the file/copy contents, not while the panel is reading the selected local file.
Browser tests use a synthetic connector and virtual clock. No native wallet ceremony, physical suspend test, full regression or container refresh.
